line: Crowley's account of Atu XII: the letter Mem, the element Water, and the sacrifice he reads in the figure.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter is named in the text, so it is not table-only. The element is Water in the text and the table.

quotes.quote: This card, attributed to the letter Mem, represents the element of Water.
Yet the card in itself is essentially a glyph of Water; Mem is one of the three great Mother Letters

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: The text gives no ends for this path. The table gives Key Scale path 23, and the general rule is one letter to each of the twenty-two paths.

quotes.quote: These paths are the paths which join the ten numbers on the
and one letter goes to each path.

sections.title: What the card figures, in his words
sections.line: Crowley's description of the figure and the act shown on the card.

quotes.quote: it is a baptism which is also a death.
The Atu represents the sacrifice of “a male child of perfect innocence and high intelligence”
